counselling_points: Carrier status is common and is not a disease - both partners must be carriers for a 25% child risk in autosomal recessive disorders.
Carrier screening is a simple blood test (HPLC/CBC for thalassemia, enzyme assay for G6PD).
Prenatal diagnosis (CVS at 11-13 weeks or amniocentesis at 15-18 weeks) is available at select centres.
Consanguineous marriage increases the risk of autosomal recessive disease in offspring.

government_schemes.name: National Policy for Rare Diseases 2021
government_schemes.authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
government_schemes.benefit: Financial assistance up to INR 50 lakh per patient for treatment of listed rare diseases at Centres of Excellence (one-time) under the NPRD 2021 framework.
government_schemes.applies_to: Listed rare diseases incl. many lysosomal storage disorders, SMA, DMD (as per group)

government_schemes.name: Sickle Cell Anaemia Elimination Mission
government_schemes.authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / Ministry of Tribal Affairs
government_schemes.benefit: Population-level screening (7 crore people in 17 states), counseling and treatment; targeted at tribal districts.
government_schemes.applies_to: Sickle cell disease carriers and patients

government_schemes.name: UMMID (Unique Methods of Management and treatment of Inherited Disorders)
government_schemes.benefit: Genetic carrier screening, prenatal diagnosis and counseling for thalassemia and other inherited disorders at designated centres.

government_schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
government_schemes.benefit: Health cover up to INR 5 lakh per family per year for secondary/tertiary care for eligible families.
government_schemes.applies_to: Rare disease supportive care where covered

government_schemes.name: National Newborn Screening Program (RBSK/NHM linked)
government_schemes.benefit: Newborn screening for congenital hypothyroidism, CAH, G6PD deficiency, PKU and hemoglobinopathies in expanding state programs.

government_schemes.name: Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK)
government_schemes.benefit: Child health screening and early intervention services including 4 Ds (defects, deficiencies, diseases, developmental delays).

centres_of_excellence: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi
